result:
I fixed the README's KPI map, and `gov accept DAEO-drhj` now reads it: all seven KPI lines are mapped, none is unmapped. Every case still fails on the base, as expected, since there is no `skilleval` command there yet.

task: fix `tests/acceptance/W2-104/README.md` so that `gov accept` reads a map naming every KPI line (success 1 to 4, failure 1 to 3) with its cases, without changing any test
status: DONE — `gov accept DAEO-drhj` no longer refuses with `ACCEPT_NO_MAP`, and nothing is unmapped
work_completed: I rebuilt the map table in the runner's form. The columns are `KPI line | What the cases hold | Tests | Red reason on the base`. Each `Tests` cell holds only code spans of the form `test_w2_104_<file>.py::<function>`. The notes on parametrized variants and the loose code spans (`SKILL.md`, `version`, `denied`, whole file names) moved into the "What the cases hold" column, which the runner does not read. If they had stayed in the Tests column, the reader would have taken them as items, and a bare file name would have mapped every case in that file. One line above the table says the map is in `gov accept`'s form. The Success 2 row now also names the refusal cases, because that KPI line says "refuses … otherwise". This only adds to the line; nothing is lowered. No test changed.
files_changed: tests/acceptance/W2-104/README.md
evidence: Sandbox check first. (a) The write to `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/.sandbox-trial-DAEO-drhj` failed with `OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`, so no file was made. (b) `git hash-object -w --stdin` worked (`1ae28402a109`) and `git update-index --refresh` worked (exit 0). Identity: `independent-test-designer` / `DAEO-drhj`, `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-104-tests`, `w2/W2-104-tests`. The commit is `09d9f89bd183` "W2-104 tests: the README's KPI map in gov accept's form (a Tests column)", with trailers Task: DAEO-drhj, Role: independent-test-designer, Implements: DEC-959,DEC-820, Rewrite-Reason: DEC-959 item 6: gov accept reads the map from a Tests column; the README's map was unreadable (ACCEPT_NO_MAP), Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5. Only the README is in the commit. The runner (`PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-104-tests/src python3 -m gov.cli.main accept DAEO-drhj --json`) gave exit 3 with `ok: true` and `outcome: fail`. Per line: success-1 0 passed / 16 failed; success-2 0 / 15; success-3 0 / 9; success-4 0 / 3; failure-1 0 / 7; failure-2 0 / 13; failure-3 0 / 4. `unmapped` is 0 / 0 / 0 and the totals are 0 passed, 43 failed, 0 skipped. Each line's count matches the cases the README names, with parametrized variants counted.
tests: `gov accept DAEO-drhj` ran the W2-104 suite in its child: 43 failed, 0 passed, 0 skipped, which is expected on the base (no `skilleval` command).
discoveries: `parse_map` in `src/gov/accept/runner.py` takes every code span in the Tests cell as an item. A bare `file.py` item matches every case in that file, so notes in code spans in that cell would over-map or add unmatched items. The other table in this README (`Marker (in) | Stub behaviour`) has no Test or File column, so the runner skips it.
risks: If a case is renamed, its `::` item stops matching; the runner then fails that line rather than passing it silently (`names_a_test`).
lessons: Under `gov accept`, a README map needs a header cell that starts with `Test` or `File` (case-insensitive). Its cells should hold only `file::function` code spans, with notes kept in another column.
